channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Norway's grid operator Statnett on Monday paused new grid reservations for data centres until as late as 1 August 2027 and the government said it will license data centres, after requests reached 31 GW in a country whose peak demand is just over 25 GW. Builders are answering queue risk by owning generation: SpaceX filed a hearing notice for a roughly $24 billion gas-fired plant and super-compute facility at Starbase, Texas, and PPL's Invitium agreed terms to build about 2 GW of gas, fuel cells and batteries for a single QTS campus in Pennsylvania, where PPL's advanced pipeline is now 35.3 GW. Nvidia fell for a second day, down nearly 6% by late morning Eastern on Tuesday, after The Information reported at least $7.5 billion of its hardware reached Chinese buyers through a network linked to the Megaspeed executive at the centre of the board's investigation; AMD and Broadcom rose. Europe slipped again: EuroHPC voided every AI gigafactory tender for technical reasons, with large sites now due 3 December and medium sites 4 February. Live list prices held: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 10 November 2026
item.description: Norway's grid operator Statnett on Monday paused new grid reservations for data centres until as late as 1 August 2027 and the government said it will license data centres, after requests reached 31 GW in a country whose peak demand is just over 25 GW. Builders are answering queue risk by owning generation: SpaceX filed a hearing notice for a roughly $24 billion gas-fired plant and super-compute facility at Starbase, Texas, and PPL's Invitium agreed terms to build about 2 GW of gas, fuel cells and batteries for a single QTS campus in Pennsylvania, where PPL's advanced pipeline is now 35.3 GW. Nvidia fell for a second day, down nearly 6% by late morning Eastern on Tuesday, after The Information reported at least $7.5 billion of its hardware reached Chinese buyers through a network linked to the Megaspeed executive at the centre of the board's investigation; AMD and Broadcom rose. Europe slipped again: EuroHPC voided every AI gigafactory tender for technical reasons, with large sites now due 3 December and medium sites 4 February. Live list prices held: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: Norway: Statnett pauses new data centre grid reservations until as late as 1 August 2027; government plans a licensing regime (Wire, 9 Nov, confirmed). United States: SpaceX files for a roughly $24 billion gas plant and super-compute facility at Starbase, Texas; tax abatement hearing 9 December (Wire, 9 Nov, Reuters single-source). United States: PPL's Invitium agrees terms for about 2 GW of generation for QTS in Salem Township, Pennsylvania; PA pipeline 35.3 GW (Wire, 6 Nov, confirmed). China: The Information reports at least $7.5 billion of Nvidia hardware reached Chinese companies since 2023 via a Megaspeed-linked network (Wire, 10 Nov, single-source). Singapore: Equinix opens SG6, 8 MW now and up to 20 MW, among the first sites built under the call-for-application regime (Wire, 6 Nov, confirmed).
